description: Compact live navigator preserves section access (REQ-027; C54, G22; R35, R98; AC-C54-01, AC-R027-01; JOURNEY-027). On the real /workout route the live section header is the accepted compact navigator (SectionHeader compact in src/ui/workout-chrome.tsx; reference eded158cfd928d382c9a9409e2c372270312741d, /gallery/refinements?state=cards): All sections with the N / M position over the collapsible, status-bearing jump list, with no section card, visible title, status line or Structures in this section badge list repeating the active card's identity. The section's level-two heading and its Section N / M · status reading stay for assistive technology, visually hidden; the trigger keeps the one name All sections. A jump from the list moves focus to the opened section's first card (owner decision 2026-11-10, option a); Previous and Next keep focusing the section heading. A jump records, corrects, clears and completes nothing, moves no section status and does not reset the session clock or a logged set. The gallery state ?state=cards draws the same consumer before its live cards over a memory-only position. check-01 proves the component, the real route over in-memory doubles and the gallery in jsdom; check-02 proves the route in the browser at 320 and 390 with a contained synthetic started session, touch, keyboard, reduced motion, a failed read and its retry and a reload, and the gallery state. Every declared case must execute and pass.
